insight: One of the oldest consumer AI companions (2017); its NSFW roleplay was removed in 2023 then restored after backlash, and Italy fined it €5M.
name: Replika
tagline: An AI companion that learns your personality through ongoing conversation.
description: A long-running consumer AI companion app you customize as a friend, mentor, or partner, with a persistent avatar and memory of past chats. The free tier supports unlimited text chat; Pro unlocks voice/video calls, relationship roles, and additional personality traits.
edge: One of the oldest consumer AI companions (2017), with the deepest track record on long-term persona and memory.
cons: Abruptly cut then restored romantic content (2023)

references.title: Italy fines AI chatbot maker Replika €5 million over privacy violations
